name: Kindling App
tagline: Turns real app screenshots into punchy vertical video for launch posts
description: A marketing collaborator for a mobile app launch. Hand it genuine captures from inside your product and it builds short-form vertical cuts with bold on-screen text and phone-style framing, then keeps revising the edit until the version you asked for is the one you get.
author: gohooper
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
